brand.name: kingXford & Co
brand.purpose: Prepare people and institutions for sustainable abundance by turning intelligence, research, responsible AI, and aligned investment into durable capability.
brand.positioning: An intelligence, research, and development company that helps people and institutions solve complex problems and develop ambitious ideas, projects, and systems through Studio, the Living Room, and Lab.
audiences: Investors of capital, time, expertise, infrastructure, access, or trust

concept.name: Documented Practice
concept.thesis: A restrained corporate wordmark, authentic product evidence, and grounded documentary imagery give kingXford & Co authority without turning the identity or imagery into spectacle.
concept.memorable_mechanism: the X remains on the same baseline and at the same optical scale as the surrounding letters, with colour as its only emphasis; a compact K monogram serves icon contexts
recognition_signals: ultramarine used for navigation and selective emphasis
authentic public-product captures and source-recorded documentary photography

logo_assets.status: original implementation asset; legal and trademark review not performed

logo_rules.clear_space: At least one quarter of the mark's outer width on every side.
logo_rules.minimum_size: 16 CSS px for favicon use; 24 CSS px for interface use.
backgrounds: solid ultramarine when the mark is reversed to bone
prohibited_uses: Do not rotate, skew, outline, or add glow.
Do not enlarge, raise, isolate, or turn the X into an architectural emblem.
Do not emphasize the X with scale, weight, animation, or geometry; colour is sufficient.
Do not replace the restrained wordmark or K monogram with generated lettering.
Do not place over a detailed image without a solid contrast field.
Do not imply trademark clearance or exclusivity.

primary.name: electric ultramarine
primary.role: strand, active states, and primary accent

display.behavior: Editorial, compact tracking, responsive optical scale; reserve italics for a single meaningful turn.

body.behavior: Readable at 16px or larger with a 1.55–1.7 line height and 55–72 character measure.

mono_or_data.behavior: Use only for coordinates, issue IDs, and compact metadata.

fallbacks: Arial and system sans-serif for interface and body

layout_grids: Mobile: 4 columns, 16px gutters, 16px minimum side margin.
Wide: 12 columns, 24px gutters, fluid side margins, 1440px primary content cap.

geometry: Circular controls only when the control behavior warrants the shape
radii: 999px only for compact pills and status tags
shadows: Controls rely on contrast and border before shadow

subjects: Authentic public-product interface captures for published digital work.
Licensed documentary production, design, architecture, and laboratory environments when source, restrictions, dimensions, and checksums are recorded.
Adults visible in documentary sources are contextual subjects only, never kingXford & Co staff, clients, study participants, or endorsers.
composition: preserve authentic product hierarchy and readable interface evidence inside the central crop-safe region
retain a clear documentary focal subject without changing the meaning of the source
deliberate negative space for adjacent HTML type
do not fabricate brand geometry, props, people, screens, or environments into product captures or documentary photographs
camera: restrained editorial wide or normal perspective
no drone-like or impossible viewpoint unless the object is explicitly a scale model
lighting: natural or documented production light for licensed photographs
restrained grade that preserves photographic truth
no unexplained glow, synthetic relighting, or generative fill applied to documentary sources
color_treatment: rare project-specific red, gold, and green punctuation
exclusions: generated, synthetic, or hybrid imagery on active product, cinematic, world, or Media surfaces
invented readable text, interface states, metrics, testimonials, citations, or product claims
authentic_media_policy: Every active project image is either a mechanical crop or composition of authentic public-product captures, or a source-recorded documentary photograph.
Mechanical product compositions may crop, scale, frame, and place authentic captures on neutral fields but may not invent, rewrite, or synthesize interface content.
Documentary photographs remain contextual and must not be described as a kingXford & Co facility, employee, engagement, experiment, or measured outcome.
Use factual adjacent HTML, purpose-based alt text, and a contextual documentary caption where confusion is reasonably possible.
Record source, capture or edit date, material edits, restrictions, dimensions, release state, and final checksum in creative/rights-provenance.csv.
Previously generated and hybrid assets remain inactive historical records and may not be restored to active use without explicit direction and a new review.

construction: simple orthographic geometry; the compact K monogram uses one restrained ultramarine terminal
illustration_and_icons.line_weight: 1.75–2 CSS px at the 24px reference size
illustration_and_icons.perspective: orthographic for interface icons; shallow physical perspective for system diagrams
illustration_and_icons.color_behavior: inherit currentColor; accent only active or directional segments

principles: State changes begin immediately and remain interruptible.
The wordmark remains stable; identity letters do not assemble as spectacle.
Scroll motion crossfades authentic public-product captures and licensed documentary environments without scrubbing a short looping film.
Content never waits for a cinematic intro.
Hover and focus communicate the same hierarchy.
motion.reduced_motion: Remove path drawing, parallax, cursor following, and large spatial translation; preserve immediate opacity or color feedback and all content.

principles: Show systems depth without hiding behind jargon
Separate shipped work, active work, and concept work
Treat sustainable abundance as a research and development direction disciplined by evidence, ecological limits, distribution, and accountability
voice.headline_behavior: Short editorial statements with one unexpected but concrete verb.
voice.body_behavior: Explain context, decision, and consequence in compact paragraphs; avoid unsupported superlatives.

interface_tokens.focus_style: 2px solid var(--focus), 3px offset; never remove without an equivalent.
accessibility_targets: 4.5:1 contrast for normal text and 3:1 for large text and essential graphics

owners: kingXford & Co — brand and content authority
approval_rules: Project claims, external URLs, and contact details require owner verification.
A production release requires build, route, keyboard, responsive, and outbound-link checks.
Public-product capture and documentary-photo provenance must remain attached to every active cover, cinematic plate, world card, and Media image.
Generated and hybrid images are inactive historical assets and fail the active-release imagery gate.
CCAI Global, Aceplore, Nkosuo, and Elkings College remain unreleased until a verified status change is recorded.
Formal accessibility conformance, copyright, font, and trademark clearance require qualified review; none is claimed here.
asset_sources_and_licenses: Veridanth, Psyche Atlas, and GrandMaster covers are mechanical 2400x1600 compositions of authentic public-product captures; no generated field or invented interface content is present.

Value-M and the neutral prototype-workshop documentary asset are licensed from Jonathan Borba and GN Group through Unsplash; source pages and contextual restrictions are recorded. The older aceplore-real path is inactive history.
Arrival, Studio, and Studio portrait photographs are licensed from Declan Sun, Joshua Wann, and Clay Banks through Unsplash.
The laboratory landscape, laboratory portrait, and new laboratory crop restore Nathan Rimoux / Unsplash provenance; the Living Room workshop portrait is a crop of the GN Group source.
The restrained wordmark and framed K monogram are original repository implementations updated on 2026-08-01; legal and trademark review has not been performed.
Generated and hybrid assets from prior releases remain in rights-provenance.csv with inactive_historical release state.
Manrope and Newsreader: loaded through @fontsource packages; license metadata must be preserved and verified before redistribution.
Lucide interface icons: package dependency; retain its license and notices.
